name: 薩菲爾男性偏武 · 打擊樂器
prompt: Production 2D hand-painted fantasy RPG animation sprite atlas. SQUARE RGB OPAQUE PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no alpha. EXACT 6 columns by 6 rows, thirty-six SEPARATE full-body miniature sprites. Same person, costume, weapon, scale and right-facing three-quarter view every frame. Each sprite no more than 65% cell width, generous 35px magenta gutters, NO touching neighbouring poses. No text, no grid lines, no scenery or floor. Adult anatomy, fine painterly details at 150px character height, NOT chibi, NOT 3D. SUBJECT: athletic adult brown-skinned desert man with black curls and short neat beard, ivory headwrap, cobalt short coat over brass scale vest, crimson sash, loose sand-coloured trousers and dark riding boots. Held equipment MUST be: a round frame drum held in left hand and played with right palm. SIX ROWS, each six frames: ROW1 idle breathing loop; ROW2 attack: ready, anticipation, windup, strong contact/release, follow-through, recovery. Raise drum, right palm hits drum face with two rhythmic beats and small golden sound rings, then settle. ROW3 hit recoil and recovery; ROW4 defensive guard and recovery using this actual equipment, no extra sword; ROW5 evasive crouch step then recovery; ROW6 collapse/defeat ending lying motionless. SAME costume throughout: athletic adult brown-skinned desert man with black curls and short neat beard, ivory headwrap, cobalt short coat over brass scale vest, crimson sash, loose sand-coloured trousers and dark riding boots. Weapon must remain recognizable, same proportions, grip anatomically correct. No swords except those explicitly requested. No touching neighbours. Solid opaque magenta everywhere between characters, no transparency. 6 columns, 6 rows, 36 poses.
